aclDescription: Sharing grants access to this task and its descendants, including comments, documents, and run history. Parents and siblings need separate access.
title: Who can access this task
empty: Only you can see this task.

subtitle.implicit: {{role}} — access remains while this role applies
subtitle.inherited: Inherited access — managed at its source

caution.title: Shared agent.
caution.body: {{name}}'s memory & workspace may carry residual private context from this task into its later runs for other people. Grant only if that's acceptable.

revoke.title: Remove {{name}}'s saved grant?
revoke.bodyBefore: This removes this grant and the access it supplies to this task's descendants. Ownership, current assignment, project membership, inherited access, or another grant can still provide access. Revoking access does
revoke.bodyAfter: erase content already seen or retained in an agent's memory.
